title: Why Does the Moon Look Huge on the Horizon? #moon
description:
It isn't bigger: a small pebble at arm's length covers the Moon high or low (about half a degree). The size change happens in your brain, and scientists still debate exactly why.

Sources
- Kaufman & Kaufman (2000), Explaining the moon illusion, PNAS 97(1), 500–505
- Kaufman & Rock (1962), The moon illusion, I, Science 136, 953–961
- Ross & Plug (2002), The Mystery of the Moon Illusion, Oxford University Press
- Wikipedia, Moon illusion

Try the pebble test tonight. Did the Moon shrink? Tell me in the comments.
